content: Liganga linaubhumi na nnima ghwa kya Chapanga
Hino, mughuleke uhokelo ghwoha, uhwangi, ufyangu, na tama hakataho, na malagho gha kukokela bhulwa.
Handa bhula bhana hing'enya pabhapala kuyonga mabhele, na mwenga mmeghe na kilyakalyaka kya mabhele gha hoto gha nhuki ngati libhatangatile kukula mu ulopohi,
handa hoto npaha na kangi nng'amula kukita Bambo ndo ywa maha.
Hino, nhike kwa nenga, ndo liganga linakulama liilemelitwe na anabhandu, peni liilingitwe na Chapanga na kangi ndo liganga linautopelo kwa ywombe.
Mwenga bhubho handa maganga ghanakulama nchengwa kwa kitutubhi kya kiuhuki, panng'egha nyambi ya kinhuki yina kunnyeleha Chapanga kukindila Yesu Kilisito.
Kiyaha matyeko gha Chapanga ghangulongela,

content.text: liganga lya kitamiko, nililingite na lya utopelo.
Mundu ywohele ywakanhyubhalila aywo kaayuyuhwa kata.”

content: Kwa mwenga munakuhyubhalila, liganga alyo ndo lya utopelo nkulu, peni kwa bhala bhanga kuhyubhalila,

content.text: hinu libhega liganga likulu lya kitamiko.”

content: Matyeko ghangulongela kangi.
Bhandu bhangulikubhala kiyaha bhangulihyubhalila ng'obhe alyo lilagho, handa palibhele likaho kutandila kalongohi.

Peni mwenga ndo kibheleko kiilingitwe, mandundame bha Kibhutwa, nnima ghwa kya Chapanga, bhandu bhake mwene Chapanga, munningitwe kulandamiha milando mikulu ya Chapanga ywakaakemite kuhuma kulubhindu, nnyingile kuulangalo ghwake ghwa kukangahya.
Kalongohi mwenga mukibhegha ng'obhe bhandu bha Chapanga, peni hinu mwenga mmegha bhandu bhake, makachu ghala mukikamuhwa ng'obhe lipyanda lya Chapanga, peni hinu nkingama lipyanda.
Andumitumi bha Chapanga
Maaghanja bhangu, nunguasigha handa ahenja na apitanjila bha apa pannima! Nnekane na tama hakataho hya mmili, hyene highulimbana na mihuki yenu.

Mmeghe na ng'endelo ya maha muulongolo ghwa bhandu bhanga kummanya Chapanga, ngati handa paabhakupukiha kukita mwenga mungutenda mahakata, bhahotole kung'amula milando yenu ya maha na habhu bhantike Chapanga pakapala kuhika.
Kya habhu munnyitikile kilongohi ywohele ywakabhikitwe na anabhandu: Yibhe ndo kwa mutwa nkulu muno,
ebu ya hilongohi bhangi bhaaalingwitwe naywo ngati bhabhakehe bhala bhaatende uhokelo na kubhatika bhala bhaatendite makataho.
Mana Chapanga kangupala nhotole kubhahibha milomo malagho gha bhandu abhughabhugha.
Kiyaha mwenga ndo mabhopwa ng'obhe, nkotoke kughutumila ghwangabhopwa ghwenu handa kikupukiho kya kutenda ulemwa, ngati ntame handa payibhanogha andumitumi ghwa Chapanga.
Mubhahokamile bhandu bhoha, muapale alongo bhenu anhyubhalilo, muntundamile Chapanga, na munhokamile mutwa.
Kughutughila nhwano ghwa kupamandika kwa Yesu
Mwenga maandumindumi, mubhayitikile mabambo bhenu kwa uhokamo ghwoha, paabhele bha umaha ebu atama nuu ebu hata paabhele akalipa.
Kiyaha ndo nnando ghwa kuyelehwa handa mundu kaalimbilila pakapamandwa kwa kubhonelwa, Chapanga kanguyelelwa
Kiyaha maamokola lilumbo ghani panlimbilila matuto ghamughanoghwa kubhukana na uhokelo ghwenu? Peni handa maalimbilila himbamanda hata payibhele ntenda gha maha, Chapanga katabhanonela kwa kya agho.
Kiyaha mwenga nkemwa kwa kya ali, mana Kilisito kakipamandwa kwa kya mwenga, kangi kakialekela nhwano, ngati ntende handa pakatendite ywombe.
Ywombe kakitenda ng'obhe ulemwa, hangi kulongela lilagho lya uhwangi mu ngulo yake likiyihwanika ng'obhe.
Pabhanlighite ywombe kakiyanga ng'obhe kwa liligho, paaghendelelite kumpamanda ywombe kakibhayoghoha ng'obhe, ngati kakibhika udumbilo ghwake kwa Chapanga, nndumula nongwa ghwa nga ubhaghulo.

Ywombe kakighutola ulemwa ghwetu mu mmili ghwake, kunani mwa lupingika lwa nkongo, ngati tuhweghe kwa milando ya ulemwa ngati tulame kwa kutenda gha maha muulongolo ghwa Chapanga, kwa hilonda hyake mwenga nlamihwa.
Mwenga mukibhegha handa mene bhaahobhite, peni hinu mummuyila nhakila na nkingikiha ghwa mihuki yenu.
